text:
samantha_peopleops: Quick thread to collect manager guidance before I publish the Q3 review timeline. Two requests: (1) confirm we're ok with a 72-hour grace for self-assessments for documented launch/travel conflicts, (2) confirm the manager summary template and whether we should require a one-line calibration rationale on each manager comment. Please reply with one-liners. :spiral_calendar:

linda_hr: 72-hour grace OK for documented conflicts. After that, managers must request an extension from People Ops and HR will log the approval. We want a one-line calibration rationale mandatory (helps speed meetings).

eng-manager-cole: Agree on 72h grace. For the manager summary template, can we require a 3-part structure so reviewers can scan quickly? Something like: Top contributions (metrics), Collab/impact, Suggested placement + 1-line rationale.

eng-manager-zoe: +1 to Cole. Also request an explicit section for new hires (<= 6 months) to explain ramp context. It reduces bias during calibration.

calib-lead-ana: Confirmed. I'll enforce a 100-150 word manager summary with those three labeled sections and an extra "Ramp note" field for hires under 6 months. For calibration, please add your one-line rationale into the "Calib rationale" column on the sheet. Leads will aggregate during the meeting.

peopleops-bot: Reminder: Managers on the early-review list have manager comment drafts due in 48 hours. Check your calendar.

linda_hr: Upload/checklist (short):
```
- IC self-assessments due: 2026-06-01 23:59 PT (72h grace -> 2026-06-04 23:59 PT if documented)
- Manager summaries (template) due: 2026-06-03 17:00 PT
- Final uploads to: /Shared/Reviews/2026-Q3/ by: 2026-06-05 12:00 PT
- Calibration votes/rationales on sheet by: 2026-06-06 10:00 PT
- Appeals window opens: 48h after final calibration notes published
```

samantha_peopleops: Two process clarifications: (A) appeals: managers can submit a short appeal (one paragraph) on behalf of an IC within the appeals window; HR triages and records outcome. (B) timezone support: for APAC-heavy teams we'll offer one evening calibration slot and asynchronous read+vote flow.

eng-manager-cole: Will forward the manager template to my team. One ask: can the sheet allow "proxy" entries for traveling managers? If so, require a short proxy rationale and who approved the proxy.

calib-lead-ana: Yes proxies allowed. Add proxy name + approver + 1-line reason in the "Proxy" columns. Proxy must be a peer manager and cannot be the direct skip-level. Leads will check proxy approvals before the meeting.

eng-manager-zoe: Small flag: for ICs on performance plans, we should include a private marker so calibrators know theres an active plan. That should be visible only to leads+HR. 

linda_hr: Agreed. We'll add a private flag column visible only to leads and HR. It won't be part of the redacted pre-read. Also: new-hire ramp guidance text managers can forward: "If hire <=6 months, include hire date, ramp milestones, and 3 concrete indicators of progress. Keep to one short paragraph."

peopleops-bot: Note: final timeline will be posted to #announcements tomorrow 10:00 PT. Managers, if you need alternatives to the live calibration times, use the async vote + comment flow on the sheet by the close time.

samantha_peopleops: Thanks all. I'll assemble the manager one-pager, paste the template into the form, and publish the timeline tomorrow. If you have any objections to the 72h grace or the one-line rationale requirement, please DM me within 6 hours. Appreciate the quick replies :white_check_mark:
